confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from two web searches: the RBA rate and one Penang cost-of-living search. That search returned Numbeo and CityCost aggregates: inexpensive meal about RM15, mid-range dinner for two about RM80, cappuccino about RM12, domestic draft beer about RM17. Those are crowd-sourced figures converted at roughly RM4.2 per USD. I found no cocktail data. The cocktail price is estimated at about 2.2 times the beer price, and the wine glass is estimated from a mid-range bottle of about RM78. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from inspecting any listings, and are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Penang (George Town) is a mid-priced Malaysian tourist city. Its prices are similar to Kuala Lumpur and a little below Singapore, and drinks carry a high alcohol tax.
